verdict.rationale: Pika is an AI creative platform with a developer API, so an official CLI is a fair thing to ask about. The evidence documents an OpenAPI spec, an MCP server, llms.txt and playgrounds, but none of it mentions an official command-line tool. The API and MCP server are adjacent developer surfaces, not a CLI, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
